title: Breath exercises
description: Guided breath exercises with a live breathiness gauge, shown in file order.

id.description: Stable id starting with b-. Practice history refers to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

cue.description: Short name on the exercise card.

sub.description: A few words under the name on the card.

aim.description: band: done after a few seconds with the gauge in the goal zone. explore: free practice with no finish.

why.description: One or two sentences on what the exercise is for.

oneOf.description: A step that depends on the training goal.

steps.description: Steps shown in order. Use an object with feminine and masculine for a step that differs by goal.
